telegram.note: Copies in this repository are sharper than the Telegram sets because Telegram compresses them.

rules.heading: Standards
items: Visual novel (galgame) stickers only — no anime, manga, or illustrations
Capture the character's ahoge in full whenever possible
Mostly small, cute, soft-moe white-haired characters
rules.note: Some early stickers do not follow these, because they were captured before the rules existed.

games.heading: Related games
lines: These are the games used in the stickers. Go play them.
I have played all of them. They are all moe games.
See which games were used for which screenshots.

items.q: Will these stickers keep being updated?
items.a: Yes. I capture stickers while playing. As long as I still play visual novels, there will be updates.
Yes. Open a PR and put your stickers in a named folder under Others.

items.q: Why is the first pack's image format mixed?
items.a: Some files were copied from QQ before this collection was deliberate. Everything new is PNG.
